description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a single PUT endpoint for updating items. It includes a Pydantic model for item data and an endpoint that demonstrates the use of request body examples.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax fields.

methods.name: update_item( item_id: int, item: Item = Body( examples=[ { "name": "Foo", "description": "A very nice Item", "price": 35.4, "tax": 3.2, } ], ), )
methods.description: An asynchronous FastAPI endpoint to update an item identified by 'item_id' with request body validation and examples.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.signature: ( item_id: int, item: Item = Body( examples=[ { "name": "Foo", "description": "A very nice Item", "price": 35.4, "tax": 3.2, } ], ), )
